notes.title: New Skins & Portuguese Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/34ead740cf2a839813a73ac5870d3d03b0cd5010.jpg[/img]

The last few weeks have been crazy. The Devespresso team hopes that everyone is staying safe during these uncertain times. If your experience has been anything like ours, then healthy social distancing and a long self-quarantine is probably the norm by now. Maybe you've even had some time to revisit that Steam backlog!  

Gloom aside, the extra time has given us cause for a few exciting announcements. We're happy to share 3 new skins for Mina that are available as DLC. They include:

[h2]The Gamer Girl[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240990/The_Coma_2_Vicious_Sisters_DLC__Mina__Gamer_Girl_Skin/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/baffa44fe6ff25def3c426cc24bb30a8559fcd2c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Local Celeb[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240970/The_Coma_2_Vicious_Sisters_DLC__Mina__Local_Celeb_Skin/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/3f341818f4f61f18d4ee88d870100a247e3a67c8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Beach Bum[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240980/The_Coma_2_Vicious_Sisters_DLC__Mina__Beach_Bum_Skin/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/b5fe57ca906096b322142f64087ee944f7b1a892.jpg[/img][/url]

Portuguese and Brazilian gamers will also be able to explore the dark halls of Sehwa in their native language. 2 new scripts have been added PT-PT and PT-BR. 

We hope these modest updates can bring a few more hours of enjoyment your way! Stay safe and if you get bored feel free to join us on Discord to speak your mind!

[url=www.discord.gg/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/dd9ca9a883beefbf5d7208d3d3c06ba5e9c8892a.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: FULL RELEASE ON JANUARY 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/d22a6a91fd7facc0cc6a83a477bdc55e7aa355c7.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that the game's FULL RELEASE will be on JANUARY 28TH. Putting the DEFINITIVE version of the game out there in the wild is an exciting milestone for the team. We just can't wait for players to see what awaits them.

We've been hard at work putting the final level of polish on the game in anticipation for this full release. Everything else has been building to this moment since we launched the game in Early Access on November 7th. Since that time, your feedback has helped shape the game in ways we would have never foreseen. We wanted to make sure everyone had a reason to return - even veteran players. So, there's A LOT of new content coming your way.

Here's just a taste:
[list]
[*] An all-new ending & theme song.
[*] New voices.
[*] Secret rooms waiting to be discovered.
[*] All bonus main screen wallpapers.
[*] Artbook and original game soundtrack.
[*] New "kill screens" (poor Mina).
[*] Trading cards.
[*] 10 new Achievements.
[*] Some major script edits (for other languages).
[*] And, of course, bug fixes (which we will continue to improve).
[/list]
Honestly, there are so many small touches that we've added here and there throughout the experience, it's difficult to list them here. We're sure you'll appreciate all of them though. Join us on Discord and meet your fellow adventurers today!

[url=www.discord.gg/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/dd9ca9a883beefbf5d7208d3d3c06ba5e9c8892a.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 0.3.2 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/3d01e64048564956503330cf45f53c3e2d656494.jpg[/img]

Hello folks,

Patch 0.3.2 just went live. So, what can you expect from the latest update? Let’s get into it:
[list]
[*] Police Office’s front yard was cleaned: Some of the suspense felt a bit weird when Mina observes strange vines outside the police station. This has been cleared away. In addition, we’ve added a few other details like a street light, police office deck, and other road decorations.
[*] Added a  Right-wing to the Old School: The save point and hiding spot was altered slightly and we added a new floor before the mystery room.
[*] Audio mixer arrangements & volume was edited.
[*] The English and Korean loc text were updated. You’ll find the script becoming more refined with added nuance or  misunderstood lines being removed.
[*] Voices and SFX for the Killer(s) have been added and edited. 
[*] The Ultimate Killer’s now has a unified BG color change when the game transitions to her appearance.  
[*] There’s a new sound effect for Mina when she dies in the final fight. Pity the girl!
[*] The puzzle of the Old Library has been refined.
[*] Mouse roll-over bug on the Game Over & Pause menu was fixed.
[/list]

[h3]DLC[/h3]
A lot of rumors and questions have been floating around about DLC for The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters. Please keep in mind that we’re trying to do everything in stride and deliver the best content possible with what we have (4 guys working round the clock). Our top priority, at the moment, is making sure the game’s full launch goes well!

That said, the current DLC we have planned is a new costume pack for Mina. No announcements to be made yet about what costumes will be in the pack or how many though!

[h3]FEEDBACK[/h3]
We’re still collecting feedback as we get closer to the full launch. We ask that anyone who finished the game please submit their thoughts here (if you haven’t yet):
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1ip4JG2FZBrxmh3v4HYrvOQ_U7NCUD0cMpiCkaIvS6s-SmA/viewform?usp=sf_link

We’re taking all of this very seriously and want to use the data to enhance future experiences in our creative universe. 

[h3]DISCORD[/h3]
[url=www.discord.gg/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/dd9ca9a883beefbf5d7208d3d3c06ba5e9c8892a.jpg[/img][/url]

Before you leave, make sure that you join our Discord server. It’s growing every day with dedicated channels to discuss the games and more (even in your own language)! You may even be able to chat directly with the devs.

notes.title: Update 0.2.5 is live - Including the next 3 Chapters!
notes.content:
Howdy Folks!

Version 0.2.5 is officially here! We hope you're as excited to jump into the next 3 chapters of the game as we are to share them. In addition to that content, we've also done extensive QOL work on the first 3 chapters and the game as a whole. We were able to accomplish this with the community's invaluable feedback. Please continue to share your opinions or any bugs you find [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/devespresso]through Discord[/url] [www.discord.gg/devespresso] or right here on the Steam Discussion boards. 

We have done multiple playthroughs where we don't encounter any significant issues. We still stumble across the odd bug or typo here and there though. Remember, the game is still in Early Access until January. So, you can expect to encounter a few hiccups. If you do, please report it and we'll patch it right away. IF you do encounter an issue, it will probably fall into one of these categories: 

[list][*] Minor graphical glitches
[*] Typos in the script
[*] Random bugs
[*] Aberrant or missing sound effects
[*] An AI that doesn't always function as intended
[*] Missing content (Bonus wallpapers, etc.)
[/list]

[b]Finally, onto some of the fixes. Frankly, they're too numerous to really outline, but here are the major changes:[/b]

[h1]SCRIPT CHANGES [/h1][list][*] So many lines of dialogue from Chapters 1-3 were adjusted to either serve their intended nuances or fix typos.
[/list]

[h1]CRAFTING[/h1][list][*] Double-crafting bug Fixed
[*] Crafting after the chapter bug fixed
[*] Crafting Difficulty corrected - it will be more challenging.
[*] Crafting Resource loot events will be disabled after each chapter.
[/list]

[h1]STORY[/h1][list][*] [Chapter 1]: We made the Storage Room telescope functional in The Coma since most gamers skip it entirely in the Waking World.
[*] [Chapter 3]: Fixed apothecary scenario skip to pick up the Grimseng.
[*] [Chapter 3]: One more note was added about the Dokkaebi.
[*] Language Update: General fixes and adjustments
[/list]

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1][list][*] Logo image correction (Size and spelling)
[*] Erased the herbal store’s background.
[*] The Butcher’s animations were improved.
[/list]

[h1]GAME BALANCE[/h1][list][*] Adjusted loot events based on player feedback.
[*] Shadow Stalker Speed has increased.
[/list]

[h1]PATH[/h1][list][*] Invisible wall correction
[*] Dark Song/Butcher chase freeze bug fix.
[*] Barricaded doors fix.
[*] School structure was edited for story expansion. (Location & inner event fix)
[*] Fixed the 1F Right Wing Hallway of the school.
[*] Patrol Route updates & corrections.
[*] General loot event updates.
[*] Moved a Noxious Fumes bomb Trap that hit people as they arrived in the Bio Lab.
[*] Back-locked Doors: Added sounds for unlocking locked doors from the inside.
[*] Operational sounds on keypad combinations were added.
[/list]

[h1]GUI[/h1][list][*] Wight Burrows have a map-checker icon now.
[*] The tutorials menu has been updated adjusted and new content was added.
[*] Tutorial update.
[*] Lighter: Activating it is not the "F" key instead of "T" (which is used for Spectral Matches).
[*] Item descriptions have been updated.
[*] The cost of some items has changed.
[/list]

[h1]DIALOGUE[/h1][list][*] Dimmed portraits were corrected.
[*] Dialogue portraits were corrected.
[*] Added Mina’s portraits to more interactive events.
[/list]

[h1]SOUND[/h1][list][*] Hyung-bae, the mysterious man, has had a voice correction.
[*] Manhwa Cutscenes had sound fixes.
[*] Various SFX were added.
[/list]

[h1]KOREAN LOCALIZATION[/h1][list][*] 국문 번역 전체적 수정 - 좀 더 디테일한 이야기 전개 및 캐릭터 심리묘사 및 발전 단계 구축.
[/list]

Early Access has giving us the opportunity to really make [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] the best it can be. Thanks again to everyone for the amazing support! You guys really keep us going. The next update will be in mid-December for the closing chapter of Mina's journey.

Team Devespresso, out!

notes.title: Update 0.2.3 is live!
notes.content:
Howdy y’all!

Tris here with another patch update. The theme for patch was “rebalancing.” Aside from that, we’ve also added some pretty cool new content into the mix. We hope everybody gets a kick out of it. Without further ado:
[list][*] The Butcher: We added a bloodlusted Butcher who will chase you throughout the Market before Song’s arrival.
[*] Manhwa Cutscenes: All new cutscenes were added and others were polished.
[*] Expanded School Quest: New drama unfolds between the teachers of Sehwa High.
[*] New Quest Text: English and Korean quest text is finished. It’s a work in progress for the other languages.
[*] Black Cat: A cute black cat was added to the market. Can you spot him?
[*] School Toilet Entering Directions are fixed.
[*] Police direction is fixed.
[*] School security office fixed / It won’t open unless you have the keycard.
[*] Police Office Monster Patrol waypoint group has been updated. Dark Song will patrol more intelligently.
[*] Market Monster Patrol waypoint group has been updated. Dark Song will patrol more intelligently..
[*] The Shady Engineer (Noteman) in the Market will continue the conversation, so players may inquire about the sticky trap more easily.
[*] Dark Song’s (Zero) detection range: 4000 -> 3000
[/list]

[b]Loot:[/b]
Loot was reduced by 40%. Most loot drops will be coins, matches, and water. When it comes to food, you probably need to purchase that at a vending machine.

[b]Inventory GUI:[/b]
Inventory GUI was updated. Now, you can only have ‘1’ mace canister at a time. However, it will not use up a slot of your inventory (like coins). The logic being that it’s small, but complicated enough to use that Mina wouldn’t know how to fumble around with 2 bottles in an emergency. 

Some dialogue directional boxes have been toward to wrong character. It fixed.


[b]Korean Localization Fix:[/b]
[list][*] 철물점 지하에 못상자가 있다는 말 -> 철물점 가게 안으로 바뀜.
[*] 미나가 실수로 인지하지 못한 상황에서 서명을 한 것으로 수정함. (이름을 적으라는 직접적인 내용을 듣는 게 아닌 것으로 바뀜)
[*] 세회 -> 세화
[/list]

[b]Additional:[/b]
[list][*] Double Click Function on the Note UI
[*] Double Click function on the Inventory and the vending machines
[*] Mina Mace SFX Fix
[*] From now on, Mina won’t stop walking when you drain her Stamina. She will instead walk slowly like Coma 1
[*] Gamma In-game Module Fix
[*] In control upgrade: XB 1 Controller FIX! (Evading will no longer interfere with running.)
[*] Market has one more hiding spot
[*] Speaker-phone sound volume Fix
[/list]

[b]Black or Grey Screen after the Logo:[/b]
We made a patch for it. If you still encounter this, please make sure ‘.Net 3.5’ or higher is installed.

[b]Ultimate Song:[/b]
When you are captured by Dark Song, there will be a short moment before the QTE begins.

As always, please continue to share your feedback on the game. It’s really helping a lot! Also, please drop by our official Discord server. We now have language specific channels, so you can chill out in your mother tongue!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045720

notes.title: Update 0.2.2 is live!
notes.content:
Howdy y’all!

Some of you were curious about what got updated in the last patch. So, without further ado, here are the Patch Notes for Version 0.2.2:
[olist]
[*] Cursor:  If your mouse unmoved on the screen for over 10 seconds it will now vanish. If you move it again, it will reappear
[*] To-Do List: You can collapse it by pressing tab (or the RB/R1) Key. It will appear when you press the button again. The To-Do icon was moved to the top right while the NIMP buttons were moved to the bottom left
[*] Market / Underground Key will be easier to find than it was in 0.2.0
[*] UI Graphical Fix / Color correction
[*] Dokkaebi Contract Event Scene was polished.
[*] We received a notification from UnlocTeam (our European Localization partners) about two minor fixes
[*] German Language - Bonus Menu text has been adjusted
[/olist]
We're making a lot more adjustments and will be rolling out 0.2.3 very soon. So, stay tuned and please continue giving us your valuable feedback!
